function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您需要今天美國黃金的即時價格，建議您參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|----------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/GC=COM | 提供即時行情、歷史走勢與新聞 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ | 以「金價」為主題，提供即時報價與圖表 |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 具備即時報價、技術分析工具 |
| 美國商品期貨交易所（CME） | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metal/precious/gold.html | 官方期貨價格與合約資訊 |

如果您想要快速查看今日黃金價格，您可以直接在瀏覽器搜尋「Gold price today」或使用上述網站的即時行情頁面。若您需要更進一步的分析或歷史資料，我也很樂意協助！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or explain. We can also ask for clarification. But likely we should respond that we don't have real-time data.
